detail.longDescription: Skynet is becoming an AI factory Week of October 26 to November 1. Skynet, our agent orchestrator, took its first step towards becoming an AI factory. It learned to carry a change all the way: push the branch, open the PR, wait for CI, fix it and merge. Along the way we found out how many tests were passing on whatever the previous one left behind. https:// backendtothefuture.com/en/blog /skynet-is-becoming-an-ai-factory/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=blog_2026&utm_content=skynet-is-becoming-an-ai-factory-en # Weekly # AIAgents # Skynet # AIFactory
